about: The mutant ledger of runtime/v1: edits of the runtime's source (runtime/v1 and the runtime/rt clock it parks on) that some runtime/v1 test must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./runtime/v1; the runner judges it by runtime/v1's own tests (docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger"). Seeded in batch 14 from the mutants batch 13 killed by hand (fua-b round 2 and its verifier, /home/exedev/.cache/baton/wf10/batch-13/verify/verdicts-2.md).

mutants.name: x7-law-sibling-unchecked

mutants.name: x8-name-base-only
mutants.rule: The file is named relative to the folder of the program's files (its package path), not by its base name.

mutants.name: x8-names-not-sent
mutants.rule: A worker's outcome carries the run's handle names to the search.

mutants.name: x8-set-spawning-unseen
mutants.rule: In an explored run a Set member's end waits for the owner's spawn through the scheduler, not on the Set's lock with the baton held (else the run hangs).

mutants.name: dh1-renew-unbound

mutants.name: dh1-recover-hosts-kept
